prompt: Who generates answers on this mesh?
chosen: Only pi4 generates tokens for the user. pi2 and pi3 are non-generative (cache/train/health).
rejected: Any Pi can generate; we load the same chat model on all three for failover.

prompt: pi4 is unreachable and the question is new. What should happen?
chosen: Fail closed with a named error for the miss. Keep serving canned hits. Never demote generate to pi2/pi3.
rejected: Silently fall back to pi3 with a small model so the user still gets tokens.

prompt: After a successful post-train update, what happens to raw shards?
chosen: Delete raw training shards on pi3; retain compact map, metrics, and budgeted adapters/weights.
rejected: Keep all raw conversation dumps forever for future research on the SD card.

prompt: Should we run CNN-based chat on the secondaries?
chosen: No. Chat uses a transformer decoder on pi4. CNNs are for optional later vision/sensor paths, not user chat decode.
rejected: Yes — a CNN language model on pi2/pi3 is a fine generative fallback.

prompt: Should every turn decode on pi4?
chosen: No. Probe the canned map first so recurring turns are local I/O; only misses decode on pi4.
rejected: Yes — always decode on pi4 and ignore the dataset for consistency.

prompt: Is the KV cache our long-term knowledge store?
chosen: No. KV cache is ephemeral working memory for the current decode on pi4. Long-term predetermined answers live in the dataset map.
rejected: Yes — keep expanding the KV cache across boards as shared memory.

prompt: Can we publish real household chat logs to the public dataset repos?
chosen: No. Public HF/Kaggle packages are synthetic seeds only. Real exchanges stay on-mesh under train→delete hygiene.
rejected: Yes — upload raw logs to grow the public corpus faster.

prompt: May train share the same memory pressure as the live chat path?
chosen: No. Isolate train jobs (pi3 queue/sandbox or HF Jobs for heavy CPT) so chat never shares OOM with training.
rejected: Run full fine-tunes on pi4 while users chat; it's fine if latency spikes.
